Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.core

Class TelemetryEventFactory

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.core.TelemetryEventFactory
public class TelemetryEventFactory extends Object
Creates every kind of telemetry event with the right type, timestamp and details.
